description: Get a Clerk organization by ID, with its 10 newest members, their roles and permissions, and a link to the organization in the Clerk Dashboard. Private metadata is never returned. Clients that support MCP Apps also show the organization as a card. To find an organization ID from a name or slug, use list_organizations. To page through or search members, use list_organization_memberships.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: get_organization

memberships.description: The newest members, as list_organization_memberships returns them.

title: Get Clerk organization
